name: 28723 · Cullowhee, NC
findings: ZIP 28723 (Cullowhee) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28723 (Cullowhee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
81% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28723 (Cullowhee) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
